name: sdv-runtime-fork
description: Want to try out SDV (Software Defined Vehicles) without installing lots of things? The sdv-runtime Docker container has everything you need to run your QM apps. It's made for people who are new to SDV and want to learn and practice without a complicated setup. The `sdv-runtime` connects natively with [playground.digital.auto](https://playground.digital.auto) where you can ideation, coding and present your automotive feature.
